summary: API-key usage middleware records invalid/overlong client IP as none instead of a 500.

statements.why: Bug fix in usage logging; no new exposure.

statements.text: There's now a maximum address length of 45. backend/src/modules/api_keys/usage.py
statements.why: 45 limit already existed on DB columns; real change is that bad/overlong forwarded IPs are stored as empty instead of crashing the request. 'Address' reads like email/postal.

misses.what: Fixes a production 500: with TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS set, a junk/overlong X-Forwarded-For made an API-key request fail after its change was saved; now it succeeds and the usage row has no IP.
